The top view shows the loupe in an open position, revealing a convex glass lens housed in a circular metal frame attached to a hinged, teardrop-shaped protective casing. The bottom view shows the loupe closed, with the lens retracted into the casing. Both views feature engraved text on the metal surface.

The metal texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine micro-scratches or machining lines typically found on real metal tools. The reflections are slightly soft rather than sharp.
